source: Reported by the Zyqora team from their training run (MacBook Air M3, PyTorch MPS). Not reproduced in this repository. Development validation results, NOT independent TEST or official hackathon results.
limitations: Two trained classes only (Organic, Recyclable); no Residual class.
Softmax scores are not calibrated probabilities; calibration has not been measured.
A confidence threshold does not reliably detect items outside the two classes.
Raspberry Pi latency, CPU and memory must be measured on the Pi (scripts/benchmark_pi.py).
